data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/widgets.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/widgets.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). Requires the widgets map; allows extends (widget-library ref) and defaults_by_type. Permissive on per-widget invoke recipe shape — runtime validator handles vocabulary checks.
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled for v0

title: Spec 60 — widgets.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS widgets.yaml file after the _meta block is stripped. The widgets key is required. extends and defaults_by_type are optional.

extends.description: Optional path to a widget-library file that this manifest inherits from (e.g. widget-libraries/gmail.widgets.yaml).

widgets.description: Map of widget id (e.g. gmail.compose_button) → widget definition (archetype + invoke recipe).

defaults_by_type.description: Map of schema field type (text, email, list<email>, …) → default widget id. Used by fill_fields when a field has no explicit widget.
